_meta.title: FIXEO Commercial Output Policy — Hybrid Model C Freeze
_meta.note: Freezes the commercial output doctrine (Hybrid Model C) and contractual price protocol for all 8 métiers. Documentation only — no production deployment.

commercial_output_types.definition: A standardized fixed contractual FIXEO price for the declared eligible scope.
commercial_output_types.client_disclaimer: Prix FIXEO applicable au périmètre indiqué. Toute prestation hors périmètre doit être expliquée et approuvée avant intervention.

commercial_output_types.definition: A deterministic FIXEO price calculated from approved inputs and formula. Once inputs are known and eligibility is satisfied, the result is the FIXEO price for that declared scope.
commercial_output_types.client_disclaimer: Prix FIXEO calculé selon les informations déclarées. Toute modification du périmètre doit être expliquée et approuvée avant intervention.

commercial_output_types.definition: FIXEO labour component is fixed or calculated. Variable hardware/material component is separately disclosed with a price range and requires client approval before installation.
commercial_output_types.client_disclaimer: Main-d'œuvre FIXEO au prix indiqué. Toute pièce ou fourniture variable est chiffrée séparément et soumise à votre accord avant installation.

commercial_output_types.definition: A FIXEO diagnostic service with a standardized price. May be absorbed against a qualifying same-visit repair under frozen métier-specific conditions only.
commercial_output_types.client_disclaimer: Diagnostic FIXEO au prix indiqué. Son éventuelle déduction d'une réparation dépend des conditions précisées pour ce service.

commercial_output_types.definition: A calculated add-on price that applies to a qualifying primary service. Cannot be booked standalone.
commercial_output_types.client_disclaimer: Supplément FIXEO calculé selon les informations déclarées. S'ajoute au prix du service principal.

commercial_output_types.definition: A genuinely non-binding estimate. RESERVED only for services explicitly classified as estimates where evidence or scope is insufficient for a contractual price.
commercial_output_types.client_disclaimer: Estimation indicative — le tarif réel sera confirmé avec l'artisan avant toute intervention.
applies_to_calculation_models: UNIT_MULTIPLICATION_WITH_FLOOR — only when measurement uncertainty is explicitly documented
commercial_output_types.usage_constraint: MUST NOT be applied to any service classified as FIXEO_PRICE or FIXEO_CALCULATED_PRICE. Only for intentionally estimated services.

commercial_output_types.definition: No standardized FIXEO price. Scope requires artisan or project quotation.
commercial_output_types.client_disclaimer: Prix sur devis après qualification du besoin. Aucun travail supplémentaire ne commence sans votre accord.

contractual_price_doctrine.core_principle: The FIXEO price applies to the declared and eligible scope.

scope_change_protocol.trigger: Reality of the intervention differs from the declared scope
prohibitions: No price modification merely because artisan considers work harder, unless an objective frozen escape trigger applies

legacy_disclaimer_correction.legacy_text: Prix indicatif FIXEO — tarif réel confirmé avec l'artisan avant intervention.
legacy_disclaimer_correction.reason: Incorrectly implies artisan has final unilateral pricing authority even for standardized FIXEO-price services.
legacy_disclaimer_correction.action: Do not use for standardized approved services. Retire when production estimator is deployed.
